entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Sarah, I need to return this helmet I bought. It's ridiculous. I've been waiting on hold forever.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with it. To start, can I get your order number?
It's VF-8675309. Look, I don't have time for a runaround. I want to return it. I got it about a month ago.
Okay, I see the order for the Aero Road Helmet. Just so I can document this correctly, what specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

The color is completely wrong! The website made it look like a bright 'safety' orange, but this is a dull, faded red. It doesn't match my kit and I don't feel visible. The box is still unopened! It's a simple return.
I understand your frustration with the color not meeting your expectations. Let me just pull up our return policy for you.

Don't give me some policy garbage. I bought a product, it's not what I wanted, and I'm returning it. It's been 32 days. If you tell me no, I want your manager right now. I swear I will light you up on every review site on the internet.
Sir, there's no need for that. Please allow me just a moment to check the details. It's just our standard procedure... Okay, I've got it here. The policy for the helmet is a 90-day return window.
See? 90 days. So process it. Send me the label.

Yes, of course. Since your purchase was 32 days ago, you're well within that timeframe. I can definitely process this return for you. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. You should see it in your inbox in the next few minutes.
Fine. Good. That's all you had to do in the first place. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the helmet, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
